draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 207th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 21 at S. He went 212th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (13th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (6th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in tackles among the 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Buffalo Bills. 53 career games and 27 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 safety who played: 1.2% season snap share against a median of 59.9%, below the norm.
